title: Server26 Clientside Bundle
description: Lots of client-side mods for the minecraft power-user.
body:
![Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19c39c076717b11711cdbd2f5d092cd5a3aa68f2.png)
**_Improve your client side gameplay without breaking the rules!*_**


All these mods work client side. This means they can be used to play on a vanilla server. (That means you can also freely edit this pack to your needs). They aim to provide additional QoL (Quality of Life) features to what could be described as a power user.

A minimap, fast villager trading, command macros, shulkerbox and map item previews, etc...

Around a hundred mods have been curated for you. No longer scavenging for small mods that work together. Its just here in one package. Inventory sorting, fast crafting.

`*Please check in with the rules on the server you are playing on!`
